output.title: New certificate timestamp metrics exposed; Prometheus scraping is enabled
output.content: The release adds two metrics, `certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds` and `certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds`. The environment sets `prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled` and `prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort`, so cert-manager metrics are likely scraped, and a `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` is in use. The change is purely additive, so nothing is stated to break. The operator should check that Prometheus scraping, series cardinality or storage limits, and any metric-name relabel or allow/deny rules tolerate the new per-certificate series. They could also use these metrics for expiry dashboards or alerts.
